title: Laser-Damage Camera Correction
description: An offline, installable PWA that profiles a camera sensor to find dead, stuck, hot and noisy pixels — including whole laser-burn patches — then infills the damage from healthy neighbours so a wounded sensor keeps taking clean photos. Everything runs on-device; no frame ever leaves the browser.
author: Nick Sullivan

seo.title: Laser-Damage Camera Correction — Profile and Repair a Damaged Sensor In-Browser
seo.description: Profile your camera to map dead, stuck and hot pixels, then automatically infill the damage from healthy neighbours. A privacy-preserving, offline-capable PWA for laser-damaged and hot-pixel-afflicted sensors.
